stories.title: Overheid Jemen kondigt offensief aan om land van Houthi's te heroveren

en.title: Yemen government announces offensive to retake country from Houthis
en.summary: The Yemeni government launched a large-scale military operation against the Houthis, focusing on reclaiming territory held by the Iran-backed group.

stories.title: Oekraïne en VS overleggen over gesprekken met Rusland voor eind oktober

en.title: Ukraine and US consult on talks with Russia by end of October
en.summary: The United States is coordinating with Russia and Ukraine to arrange peace negotiations by the end of October, according to Ukrainian President Zelensky.

stories.title: Jemenitische regering lanceert offensief om land te heroveren op Houthi’s, steeds meer partijen betrokken bij strijd in Midden-Oosten

en.title: Yemeni government launches offensive to retake land from Houthis, more parties involved in Middle East conflict
en.summary: The Yemeni government is conducting an offensive to reclaim territory from the Houthis as additional parties become involved in the broader Middle East conflict.

stories.title: Franse onderwijsminister: maandag opnieuw 400 scholen dicht

en.title: French education minister: 400 schools closed again Monday
en.summary: France's education minister announced that approximately 400 schools will be closed again on Monday.

stories.title: Brand op camping Gardameer vermoedelijk veroorzaakt door kaars in stacaravan

en.title: Fire at Gardameer camping allegedly caused by candle in mobile home
en.summary: Italian police ruled out arson in a major fire at a camping site near Lake Garda, determining it was likely caused by a candle. Four German firefighters on vacation at the site assisted in response efforts.

stories.title: Verstappen viert zege met vader: 'Start seizoen voor hem ook niet leuk om te zien'

en.title: Verstappen celebrates victory with father: 'Season start not pleasant for him to see either'
en.summary: Max Verstappen won his first Grand Prix in Malaysia using Red Bull's newly developed engine and celebrated the milestone with his father. The four-time world champion described the achievement as particularly meaningful.

stories.title: Honderden scholen in Frankrijk maandag dicht uit angst voor geweld

en.title: Hundreds of schools in France closed Monday over violence fears
en.summary: Between four hundred and five hundred secondary schools in France remained closed or operated with limited capacity on Monday following violent protests at educational institutions during the previous week.

stories.title: Gepolariseerd Brazilië maakt zich op voor stembusgang: meer afkeer dan hoop

en.title: Polarized Brazil prepares for ballot: more aversion than hope
en.summary: Brazil faces an upcoming election amid significant political polarization, with public sentiment characterized more by rejection than optimism about the electoral process.

stories.title: Regen en computerchaos kunnen dominante Verstappen niet afhouden van eerste zege in 2026

en.title: Rain and computer chaos cannot stop dominant Verstappen from first victory in 2026
en.summary: Max Verstappen won a grand prix for the first time in ten months at the Malaysia race. Many cars struggled with rainy conditions and engine issues at the start of the race.

stories.title: Trump deelt telefoonnummer senator die tegen plan voor permanente zomertijd is

en.title: Trump shares phone number of senator opposed to permanent daylight saving time plan
en.summary: The U.S. president publicly posted a senator's phone number to pressure them into supporting permanent daylight saving time legislation.

stories.title: Recordregen en overstromingen treffen Barcelona en omstreken: twee doden door noodweer

en.title: Record rainfall and floods strike Barcelona and surroundings: two dead from severe weather
en.summary: Barcelona and its surrounding areas experienced record rainfall and flooding, resulting in two deaths from the severe weather event.

stories.title: Gewonden bij brand op camping Gardameer, vakantiegangers helpen brandweer

en.title: Injuries in fire at Lake Garda campground, vacationers assist firefighters
en.summary: A fire at a large Lake Garda campground injured at least twenty people, mostly from carbon monoxide exposure. The fire destroyed approximately twenty caravans and vehicles, with one person in critical condition.
